sloka: प्रविश्य सह वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च राघवः ।तदा तस्मिन् स काकुत्स्थः श्रीमति आश्रम मण्डले ॥३-११-२२॥
transliteration: praviśya saha vaidehyā lakṣmaṇena ca rāghavaḥ ।tadā tasmin sa kākutsthaḥ śrīmati āśrama maṇḍale ॥3-11-22॥

translations.english: Illustrious Rama accompanied by Vaidehi and Lakshmana entered the hermitage and, honoured by all the sages, stayed there.
